body:
Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#190

## Summary
- Capture a centered square visualization thumbnail when saving presets and pipelines.
- Store thumbnails on saved preset/pipeline records and render saved names over the image background with contrast overlays.
- Keep legacy saved items compatible when no thumbnail is present.
- Add issue research and verification artifacts under `docs/case-studies/issue-190`.

## Visual Verification
![Saved preset and pipeline thumbnail buttons](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-190-b1a768dfa055/docs/case-studies/issue-190/saved-item-thumbnails.png?raw=true)

## Tests
- `npm run typecheck` ✅
- `npm run build` ✅
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js,cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` ⚠️
  - `preset-management.cy.js`: 11 passing
  - `pipeline-mode.cy.js`: 23 passing, 5 failing in existing broad pipeline scenarios. The new seeded pipeline thumbnail assertion passed inside the saved pipeline sidebar test; failures are logged in `docs/case-studies/issue-190/logs/cypress-focused.log`.

## Notes
- Thumbnail capture uses native Canvas 2D `drawImage()` to crop the current visualization to a 96px square data URL.
- Saved data without `thumbnail` continues to render with the previous plain button style.
